summary: Portable SUPRA PRODUCTIVITY desktop prototype progressed through v1.3-test; current focus is functional parity, UI responsiveness, Office/PDA networking, diagnostics and owner testing.
Earlier PICK flicker was traced to repeated UI checkbox events causing recalculation/render loops; v1.3 changed the interaction mechanism. Owner verification pending.

Public GitHub repository tamnv2/supra-productivity-desktop becomes canonical persistence for source, project state, decisions, sanitized debugging findings and next action. AI memory is non-authoritative when repo state exists.

Public GitHub continuity bootstrap completed: canonical project-state, next action, AI bootstrap rules, owner decisions, invariants, security guard, regression policy and sanitized session ledger are now in main.

Sanitized public Go/Win32 source reconstruction, core tests, binary public guard, Windows x64 build workflow and versioned release workflow were committed. Production credentials, private endpoint bindings, employee snapshots and raw diagnostics were intentionally excluded. Local encrypted runtime-profile provisioning and full updater installation remain next.

Implemented public-safe local runtime-profile provisioning with DPAPI and staged GitHub stable-release update with SHA256 verification, backup, replacement retry and restart. Live response binding, manual offline update and startup-health rollback remain open.

Canonical public source was verified by real GitHub PR CI after repairing DPAPI credential loading, the latest-release URL expression, and two security-guard false positives. State/public guards, go test, go vet, Windows x64 cross-build, binary scan, packaging and artifact upload all passed in run 35412096189; artifact id 10574174267. Stable release waits for owner runtime acceptance.

GitHub source/build/update continuity reached handoff state. Automated prerelease and accepted-stable workflows were added. v1.3.1-test.1 was built and published successfully by GitHub Actions (candidate run 35412269300; main build run 35412269285). Stable publication awaits explicit owner runtime acceptance.

Owner reported Not Responding and rejected UI on v1.3.1-test.1. Fixed synchronous UI-path logging risk, moved runtime logs local/non-blocking, moved navigation to bottom, expanded content area, made window full-work-area non-resizable with taskbar minimize, and requested v1.3.1-test.2.

v1.3.1-test.2 passed Project State Guard, Windows build, tests/vet, binary scan and owner-test publish. Candidate is released for target-laptop retest; stable remains blocked pending explicit owner acceptance.

Owner supplied a recovered source package from the stable V1.3 executable and directed that it become the rebuild baseline before further feature changes. Restored V1.3 business defaults/formulas and data parsing, rebased to the stable-style desktop shell, retained non-blocking diagnostics and public-safe DPAPI runtime bindings, and added prerelease-aware GitHub updater logic. Candidate updater verification is planned as v1.3.2-test.1 to v1.3.2-test.2.

Recovered V1.3 rebaseline PR #3 passed State Guard run 35419657684 and Windows Portable run 35419657703, then merged to main. GitHub prereleases v1.3.2-test.1 and identical-source v1.3.2-test.2 were published so the owner can verify the real in-app updater path from test.1 to test.2 before any further feature work.

Owner requested Excel-like bottom navigation, one comprehensive sanitized Log with user-selected export path, original Excel parity review, hang remediation and always-maximized window behavior. Candidate moves navigation to bottom, adds render/command/table/performance telemetry and panic capture, defers control refresh, suppresses ListView redraw during bulk fill, locks the window maximized and adds a sanitized Excel parity proposal. No raw workbook/log/credential data is committed.

Excel-like bottom navigation, unified sanitized Log/export, anti-freeze UI instrumentation and always-maximized window candidate passed State Guard run 35420791580 and Windows Portable run 35420791549, then merged to main at e653ff0765124f4c009fded5be14c4ad0e1c7dcf. Prerelease publication remains to be confirmed before owner runtime testing.

GitHub prerelease v1.3.2-test.3 is published after passing PR CI. Owner runtime verification is now the next action for bottom navigation, unified Log export, anti-freeze behavior and always-maximized window. Detailed Excel parity feature changes remain pending owner decisions.
